a, b, limit = map(int, input().split())
import math

g = math.gcd(a, b)
a //= g
b //= g

x_val = 0
best_x = 0
best_y = 1
factor = 1.0
tolerance = 1e-10

for y_val in range(1, limit + 1):
    while abs(factor * a / b - factor * x_val / y_val) > abs(factor * a / b - factor * (x_val + 10000) / y_val):
        x_val += 10000
    while abs(factor * a / b - factor * x_val / y_val) + tolerance > abs(factor * a / b - factor * (x_val + 1) / y_val):
        x_val += 1
    if abs(factor * a / b - factor * x_val / y_val) < abs(factor * a / b - factor * best_x / best_y):
        best_x = x_val
        best_y = y_val

result = max(0, best_x - (1 if (b == 2 and best_x != a) else 0))
print(f"{result}/{best_y}")
